Trim, resize and clean edges, in `convert` and straight after generation.

- **`--trim[=pad]`** crops transparent borders to the visible pixels; `--json` reports the crop so sprites keep their anchor. Images without a transparent border are left unchanged.
- **`--resize WxH | Wx | xH`** resamples with premultiplied alpha, so colours hidden under transparent pixels never reach the edges.
- **`--fit inside | cover | contain | fill`** decides how a box with another aspect ratio is filled.
- **Edge bleed:** PNG and lossless WebP output get the nearest visible colour under fully transparent pixels, so engines' texture filtering can't pull in a dark halo. `--no-bleed` turns it off.
- **When generating,** the same options run before saving, so a sprite goes from prompt to trimmed, resized file in one call. The untouched image is kept as `<name>.raw.<ext>`, since quota was spent on it.
